Ross Mathews told me that coinbase and Invcenter were basically the same company and worked closely together. I deposited 200k, all my savings into the platform and it was showing 470k in credit. Ross Mathews was replaced by other account managers. Jack Morrison and David west. They were going to transfer 240k to my account but again that was cancelled. They told me it was because the market was volatile due to the covid 19 pandemic. Days later the rang me to tell me they were closing all accounts under the value of 1 million pounds because of the volatility of the markets and I was at high risk of losing all the balance in my account.
